{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe there is a better way to build a thriving, equitable, and globally competitive clean energy economy that puts workers and communities first and leaves no one behind.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will help rebuild the economy from the COVID-19 pandemic and President Trump's recession by mobilizing historic, transformative public and private investments to launch a clean energy revolution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats applaud the organizing efforts of young people, union workers, and communities of color to mobilize voters and make the climate crisis a top priority.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe scientists and that the window for unprecedented and necessary action on climate change is closing, and closing fast.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats reject the false choice between growing the economy and combating climate change, believing both can and must be done at the same time.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will use federal resources and authorities across all agencies to deploy proven clean energy solutions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will create millions of family-supporting and union jobs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will upgrade and make resilient energy, water, wastewater, and transportation infrastructure.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will develop and manufacture next-generation technologies to address the climate crisis in the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will pursue these goals with an eye to equity, access, benefits, and ownership opportunities for frontline communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe environmental justice, economic justice, and climate justice must be embedded at the heart of their policy and governing agenda.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
